title: LatBridge: Efficient and Stable Model Replacement in Latent-Communication Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27813v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems rely on communication to complete tasks, and latent communication passes continuous representations to reduce text generation and re-encoding. However, multi-agent systems must reconfigure agent models, whereas existing latent-communication methods are built for fixed model combinations, so their interfaces may fail after replacement. Our pilot study confirms this interface failure and identifies the requirement for interface reuse after model replacement. We present LatBridge, which connects agent models through a shared Bridge and separate interfaces under a shared latent-communication protocol. After agent model replacement, LatBridge reuses unchanged interfaces, selects matching low-rank interfaces, and combines them through the Bridge, training only missing ones with all models frozen. translated_title: LatBridge：潜在通信多智能体系统中高效且稳定的模型替换
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统依靠通信来完成任务，而潜在通信通过传递连续表示来减少文本生成和重新编码。然而，多智能体系统必须重新配置智能体模型，而现有的潜在通信方法是为固定的模型组合构建的，因此在模型替换后其接口可能会失效。我们的初步研究证实了这种接口失效问题，并确定了模型替换后需要实现接口复用的需求。我们提出了LatBridge，它在共享的潜在通信协议下，通过一个共享的桥接器（Bridge）和各自独立的接口来连接智能体模型。在智能体模型替换后，LatBridge复用未发生变化的接口，选择匹配的低秩接口，并通过桥接器将它们组合起来，在所有模型冻结的情况下仅需训练缺失的接口。桥接器在基本模式下处理源表示，并在无需自回归生成的情况下构建目标输入。
tldr: LatBridge通过共享桥接器复用和组合独立接口，在所有模型冻结、仅需训练缺失接口的情况下，实现了潜在通信多智能体系统中高效且稳定的模型替换。
en_tdlr: LatBridge enables efficient and stable agent model replacement in latent-communication multi-agent systems by reusing unchanged interfaces and combining matching low-rank interfaces through a shared Bridge, requiring only the training of missing interfaces with all models frozen.
